name: Jina AI
summary: Jina Reader (any URL to LLM-ready markdown), Jina web search returning read pages, and Jina's embeddings and reranker models.

api_key.description: a Jina API key (jina.ai/api-dashboard/key-manager), sent as a Bearer token. Reader works without one at 20 requests a minute; search, embeddings and rerank need it.

notes: Billed in tokens from the key's balance: Reader by tokens in its output; each search costs a fixed amount starting at 10,000 tokens; embeddings and rerank by input tokens.
Reader limits: 20 RPM without a key, 500 RPM with a free or paid key. Search: 100 RPM (premium 1000). Embeddings and rerank: 500 RPM.
Reader and search take most options as X- headers or the equivalent query/body fields; send Accept: application/json for a structured answer instead of text.
web-router's own extract method already uses Jina Reader as a backend.

endpoints.name: Read a URL as markdown
endpoints.summary: Main content of a page, PDF or JS-heavy site as markdown, HTML, text or a screenshot.

respondWith.description: Output: content (default), markdown, html, text, pageshot, screenshot, and others the spec lists.

targetSelector.description: CSS selector(s) of the part of the page to keep.

waitForSelector.description: CSS selector(s) to wait for before reading.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the page, up to 180.

withLinksSummary.description: Append a summary of the page's links.

withImagesSummary.description: Append a summary of the page's images.

retainImages.description: Which images to keep, default all.

tokenBudget.description: Fail rather than return more than this many tokens.

notes: Read over POST (the simplest form is GET https://r.jina.ai/<url>). Works keyless at 20 RPM.

endpoints.name: Search the web and read the results
endpoints.summary: Top web results for a query, each already read into LLM-friendly content.

location.description: Location the search is run from.

notes: Needs a key. Each request costs a fixed token amount starting at 10,000 tokens.
Reader options (as X- headers) also apply to how each result is read.

endpoints.name: Create embeddings
endpoints.summary: Dense vectors for text (and, with multimodal models, images, audio, video or PDFs).

model.description: Model, e.g. jina-embeddings-v4, jina-embeddings-v5-text-small, jina-embeddings-v5-omni-small, jina-clip-v2. The model fixes which other fields apply.

input.description: A string, a doc object, or a list of them.

task.description: Task adapter for v3+ models, e.g. retrieval.query, retrieval.passage, text-matching.

embedding_type.description: float, base64, binary or ubinary (or a list).

normalized.description: L2-normalise (default true on models that accept it).

truncate.description: Truncate over-long input instead of failing. Default false.

notes: Read over POST, billed by input tokens. Needs a key.

endpoints.name: Rerank documents for a query
endpoints.summary: Documents reordered by relevance_score, each with its original index.

model.description: Reranker, e.g. jina-reranker-v3, jina-reranker-v3.5, jina-reranker-m0, jina-reranker-v2-base-multilingual.

documents.description: Strings or text doc objects to rank.

top_n.description: Return only the top N; default all.

return_documents.description: Include document text in results, default true.

notes: Read over POST, billed by tokens. Needs a key.

endpoints.name: List models
notes: The only api.jina.ai endpoint that needs no key.
